items.caption: An oracle-bone form of 火 catalogued with inscription 合30158. It shows the graphic variation represented in the Shang record of a graph analyzed as a picture of rising flames.
items.alt: Black oracle-bone glyph with several rising strokes joined by a curved lower line.
items.selection_reason: Its visible strokes make this sourced oracle-bone example useful for illustrating the pictographic analysis of 火.

items.caption: A distinct oracle-bone form of 火 catalogued with inscription 合17067, showing another configuration in the early record.
items.alt: Black oracle-bone glyph with a broad U-shaped outline and angular strokes inside.
items.selection_reason: The visibly different form usefully conveys variation among the catalogued oracle-bone examples without implying a chronological sequence.

limitations.text: These are modern vector renderings of glyphs catalogued from oracle-bone records, not photographs of artifacts. The cited examples are Shang-period, but their individual archaeological dates are not established here.
The rising-flame reading is a scholarly analysis of the graph; the shapes alone do not establish its historical meaning.
